halls.label: The halls
halls.text: on one level, step-free and without raised door sills. The exhibition areas are fully accessible by wheelchair.

parking.label: Parking
parking.text: A car park about a five-minute walk away is available. The few spaces directly in front of the hall are reserved for exhibitors. If you depend on a space close by, ask us in advance — we will check whether one can be kept free.

questions.label: Questions in advance
questions.text: Write to us at {email} or call us at {phone}. We will tell you honestly what is possible and what is not.

route.label: Getting to the entrance
route.text: From the Asbachgasse entrance to the main entrance it is roughly 100 metres of historic cobblestone — bumpy and tiring with a wheelchair, walker or pushchair. You do not have to cover that stretch yourself: driving into the lane is permitted, and dropping off directly at the main entrance is allowed.

toilets.label: Toilets
toilets.text: Accessible toilets are unfortunately not available. We are aware of this and we regret it.
